create_quantlinear_layer: create a QuantLinear module with 4-bit GPTQ quantization for Intel IPEX inference
pack_quantlinear_weights: pack a linear layer weight into the QuantLinear 4-bit GPTQ quantized format
post_init_quantlinear: initialize the IPEX weight-only quantized linear backend after packing QuantLinear weights
unpack_quantized_weights: unpack quantized weight and zero tensors to 8-bit signed format using unpack_to_8bit_signed
dequantize_weight: dequantize packed GPTQ weights back to full precision using dequantize_weight
